comments.text: Couldn't stop thinking of a quote by Lady Burton: "Men are four: He who knows not and knows not he knows not, he is a fool - shun him; He who knows not and knows he knows not, he is simple - teach him; He who knows and knows not he knows, he is asleep - wake him; He who knows and knows he knows, hi is wise - follow him!"
